protocol.adaptive_history: This separate protocol was designed after the complete v2 result revealed that the historical corpus generator emits only zeros in its first 4096 bytes. All v2 inputs, observations, failures of the economic gate and costs are retained. This is an adaptive engineering repair, not an independent statistical confirmation.
protocol.break_even: If a mixed workload has positive gross observed lower-envelope saving, report ceil(cold_setup_ns / gross_saving_ns) only as a conditional amortization threshold. It is not measured net profit, production demand, an acceptance criterion or NDU superiority.
protocol.cost_boundary: Cold setup includes captured-source preparation, original C differential, every root/candidate proof and compilation, sealed driver/images, data generation and the four oracle priming/cancellation traces. All policies share the same reference reuse rule and warmed reference set. Every lookup and all native contexts are timed again. Retained reference byte-time and final clearing are recorded; bank release cost is included once in cold setup. Complete-study wall retains evaluation overhead. This study does not compare cache-disabled end-to-end jobs and cannot establish an end-to-end cache speedup or NDU value.

data.encoding: ASCII domain + NUL + ASCII phase + NUL + seed encoded as unsigned eight-byte big-endian; SHAKE256 digest of exactly bytes per phase
data.selection: All 4096 bytes of each separately domain/phase/seed-bound SHAKE256 stream. Before timing, require distinct phase payloads and all 32 256-byte request chunks pairwise distinct and nonzero. These source-frozen synthetic streams do not establish external workload generalization.

protocol.deadline_scope: Acceptance deadline checked between bounded operations; not a hard global preemption guarantee. Individual children and solver queries retain separate fixed limits.
protocol.economic_gate: For all three workloads and both phases, min complete arm_host_wall_ns across all three coalesced static controls minus max complete poly-dispatch arm_host_wall_ns minus complete cold setup and release cost must be positive; distinct exported code and complete execution remain required. This is a conservative finite-job gate, with no amortized future-demand admission.
protocol.metric: Primary economic analysis uses complete arm_host_wall_ns, including request construction, plan evidence serialization, reference lookup, trace creation, native contexts and result validation. native_outer_wall_ns is reported separately and is not substituted for full host cost.
protocol.ndu_followup: This is an execution-context and fixed-policy study. NDU is not one of its five arms. A successful economic gate would only motivate a separately preregistered equal-budget native NDU versus complete enumeration and simple-search comparison; no advice, deployment or publication authority follows.
protocol.ordering: Training then validation; workload order rotates by trial. Arm order rotates by trial plus workload index and reverses on odd trials.
proof_requirements: all-input bounded captured Core bridge, truncation edge UNSAT
all-input candidate value and first-trap equivalence
sealed actual native images and bounded child lifetime
protocol.purpose: Repeat the finite reference-reuse execution matrix on a separately frozen diverse synthetic input construction after disclosing the v2 all-zero-prefix defect. Preserve every arm, budget, cost boundary and stopping rule. No independent statistical confirmation, NDU value, cache-off speedup or production-demand claim.

reference_reuse.authority: No native result, safety qualification or trace nonce is cached. Every policy executes its own actual contexts; poisoned banks never replay.
reference_reuse.key: Exact mode, seed, fixed parameter and complete values, under the immutable bank/root/checker namespace. Request ID and equivalent candidate slot remain in the consumed trace.
reference_reuse.priming: Before any timing observation, prepare and cancel four baseline traces: each phase crossed with each polynomial. No native context is executed. Charge complete preparation, lookup, storage and cancellation wall to cold setup. No oracle misses may occur in any measured arm.
reference_reuse.storage: Record exact retained canonical key+outcome bytes, entry counts, peaks, and canonical-byte nanoseconds. This is not Python RSS, physical energy, a tariff or a proof of oracle purity.

protocol.reuse_attribution: Fresh-child to coalesced-static savings measure execution-context batching only. They never establish NDU, specialization or global optimization value.
protocol.sampling: No retry, native warmup, automatic replay, outlier removal or omitted attempted sample. Two trials reuse the same fixed synthetic inputs; envelopes are not statistical confidence intervals.
protocol.source_application: examples/hia_filecheck/checksum.c via the real captured C frontend, separately proved finite loop-to-kernel bridge
protocol.source_freeze: Commit source and this protocol before execution. Local frozen-before-run only; no public preregistration is claimed.
protocol.static_control_policy: The three coalesced static arms each load exactly one referenced image. Poly-dispatch loads only its referenced images and chooses the known polynomial guard at request boundaries. This fixed dispatch is an oracle-like strong control, not an online NDU policy.
protocol.target: Linux x86_64 LP64; native current-host execution only
